title: GDEC Phase C Amendment 2 Refusal Schema & Priority Matrix

priority_order.meaning: Requested QoI is mathematically divergent or undefined in the continuous H1 elasticity formulation (e.g. singular point stress at re-entrant corner or notch tip)
GDEC does not currently support the requested functional in H1 elasticity (e.g. unregularized point displacement, patch stress, SIF direct nodal extraction)
Geometric domain contains non-finite coordinates (NaN/Inf), degenerate topology, zero-area elements, inverted elements (det J < 0), or self-intersecting boundaries
Mesh contains triangles with minimum interior angle below validated threshold (< 10.0 deg)
Linear solver relative backward error / residual exceeds validated tolerance (> 1e-10)
Fewer than 3 valid nested mesh levels available, inconsistent refinement ratio (r != 2.0), or missing M3 level in four-grid verification mode
Consecutive mesh QoI differences are unresolved relative to numerical precision floor (< 1e-13 m)
Observed convergence order p_obs is outside the validated plausibility window [0.5, 3.5]
Convergence sequence violates monotonicity (d01 * d12 <= 0) or divergence criteria (q <= 1), or four-grid stability fails (|p_012 - p_123| > 0.50)
Reference solution numerical uncertainty exceeds frozen 0.05% verification gate
Computational resource limit reached before estimated uncertainty satisfied requested tolerance
